pending

components · 0.1.1 · v4 C5 · aj-c-pending

v4 C5 (explore drafts a-quiet-line): one line of the system's quiet print for something not done yet, where it is; nothing around it changes shape. Status form: under an unsent entry or voice memo's words and tools (a row's span place), a 14px upload arrow, the words and Try again (the quiet button) at its end, role status. Draft form: under the composer's field, the voice memo draft as one whole-line button (mic, "Voice memo draft", its length in --block, "Continue" with the dotted mark) that opens the recorder on the draft.

Retrying

An unsent entry or memo, retrying on its own: under its words, in --rule-2, with Try again.

Not uploaded yet. Trying again.

Stopped

Retries have given up (offline for a while): the same line in --rule, the words say why.

Not uploaded. We can't reach the server; it tries again when you're back online.

Sending

After Try again: no button; the arrow lifts 2px and settles, --g-lift on --gc, looping (reduced motion: still).

Uploading…

Draft

The voice memo draft under the composer's field: one button, its length in --block, Continue with the dotted mark.

Draft hover

On a fine pointer Continue turns --block and its underline solid; hover it to see.

Draft focus

The product focus ring (base) round the whole line; tab to it to see.

Long

Stress test only: a long line wraps, Try again stays whole.

Not uploaded. We can't reach the server at the moment, and it will try again on its own as soon as you're back online, so there is nothing you need to do.

Non-Latin

Stress test only: Russian and Japanese, not product copy.
